description: This file defines the QrSegment class for encoding segments of data in QR codes, including static factory methods for creating segments in various modes, and internal logic for handling different data types and encoding modes.

classes.name: QrSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment of data to be encoded in a QR code, including mode, length, and data bits. Provides static factory methods for creating segments in different modes and handling encoding logic.

classes.name: QrSegment.Mode
classes.description: Enumeration of QR code data modes (NUMERIC, ALPHANUMERIC, BYTE, KANJI, ECI) with associated properties and methods for mode-specific behavior.

methods.name: makeBytes
methods.description: Creates a QR segment from binary data in byte mode.

methods.name: makeNumeric
methods.description: Creates a QR segment from a numeric string.

methods.name: makeAlphanumeric
methods.description: Creates a QR segment from an alphanumeric string.

methods.name: makeSegments
methods.description: Creates a list of segments from any Unicode string, choosing encoding modes for optimization.

methods.name: makeEci
methods.description: Creates a segment representing an Extended Channel Interpretation (ECI) designator.

methods.name: getBits
methods.description: Returns a copy of the data bits of the segment.

methods.name: getTotalBits
methods.description: Calculates total bits for a list of segments given a QR code version.
